stats.text:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or {ref:glossary/long-rest}, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

***Escape the Horde.*** Opportunity Attacks have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} against you.

***Multiattack Defense.*** When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.
